topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Present Progressive – Questions
title: Questions: Simple Present → Present Progressive

explanation.tr:
Simple Present sorusunu Present Progressive sorusuna çevir:
• Do you work? → Are you working?
• Does she work? → Is she working?
• What do they eat? → What are they eating?
Kural: Do → Am/Are; Does → Is. Fiile -ing eklenir.
explanation.tk:
Simple Present soragyny Present Progressive soragyna öwür:
• Do you work? → Are you working?
• Does she work? → Is she working?
• What do they eat? → What are they eating?
Düzgün: Do → Am/Are; Does → Is. Işlige -ing goşulýar.
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй вопрос из Simple Present в Present Progressive:
• Do you work? → Are you working?
• Does she work? → Is she working?
• What do they eat? → What are they eating?
Правило: Do → Am/Are; Does → Is. К глаголу добавляется -ing.

examples.en: Do you read? → Are you reading?
Does he cook? → Is he cooking?
What do they eat? → What are they eating?
Where does she go? → Where is she going?
Do we win? → Are we winning?
Does it snow? → Is it snowing?

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Simple Past
title: Change Simple Present into Simple Past

explanation.tr:
Simple Present cümlesini Simple Past'a çevir:
• She works every day. → She worked yesterday.
Adımlar:
1. 3. tekil -s'yi kaldır: works → work
2. Düzenli fiile -ed ekle: work → worked, live → lived, study → studied, stop → stopped
3. Düzensiz fiillerin 2. hâlini kullan: go → went, have → had, eat → ate, buy → bought
be: am/is → was, are → were
explanation.tk:
Simple Present sözlemini Simple Past-a öwür:
• She works every day. → She worked yesterday.
Ädimler:
1. 3-nji ýöňkemäniň -s-ini aýyr: works → work
2. Dogry işlige -ed goş: work → worked, live → lived, study → studied, stop → stopped
3. Nädogry işlikleriň 2-nji görnüşini ulan: go → went, have → had, eat → ate, buy → bought
be: am/is → was, are → were
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй Simple Present в Simple Past:
• She works every day. → She worked yesterday.
Шаги:
1. Убери -s 3-го лица: works → work
2. К правильному глаголу добавь -ed: work → worked, live → lived, study → studied, stop → stopped
3. Для неправильных — вторая форма: go → went, have → had, eat → ate, buy → bought
be: am/is → was, are → were

examples.en: She works. → She worked.
We go to the park. → We went to the park.
He has a cold. → He had a cold.
I am at home. → I was at home.
They study English. → They studied English.
The bus stops here. → The bus stopped here.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Simple Past – Negation of verbs
title: Negatives: Simple Present → Simple Past

explanation.tr:
Olumsuz Simple Present cümlesini olumsuz Simple Past'a çevir:
• I don't work. → I didn't work.
• She doesn't work. → She didn't work.
Kural: don't / doesn't → didn't. Fiil yalın kalır (didn't worked ✗).
be: am not / isn't → wasn't; aren't → weren't
can't → couldn't
explanation.tk:
Ýokluk Simple Present sözlemini ýokluk Simple Past-a öwür:
• I don't work. → I didn't work.
• She doesn't work. → She didn't work.
Düzgün: don't / doesn't → didn't. Işlik esasy görnüşde galýar (didn't worked ✗).
be: am not / isn't → wasn't; aren't → weren't
can't → couldn't
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй отрицание из Simple Present в Simple Past:
• I don't work. → I didn't work.
• She doesn't work. → She didn't work.
Правило: don't / doesn't → didn't. Глагол в начальной форме (didn't worked ✗).
be: am not / isn't → wasn't; aren't → weren't
can't → couldn't

examples.en: I don't like it. → I didn't like it.
He doesn't call. → He didn't call.
We aren't late. → We weren't late.
She isn't at school. → She wasn't at school.
I can't sleep. → I couldn't sleep.
They don't go out. → They didn't go out.

topic: Tenses – Shifted: Simple Present → Simple Past – Questions
title: Questions: Simple Present → Simple Past

explanation.tr:
Simple Present sorusunu Simple Past sorusuna çevir:
• Do you work? → Did you work?
• Does she work? → Did she work?
• Where do they live? → Where did they live?
Kural: Do / Does → Did (tüm özneler). Fiil yalın kalır.
be: Am/Is → Was, Are → Were
Can → Could
explanation.tk:
Simple Present soragyny Simple Past soragyna öwür:
• Do you work? → Did you work?
• Does she work? → Did she work?
• Where do they live? → Where did they live?
Düzgün: Do / Does → Did (ähli eýeler). Işlik esasy görnüşde galýar.
be: Am/Is → Was, Are → Were
Can → Could
explanation.ru:
Преобразуй вопрос из Simple Present в Simple Past:
• Do you work? → Did you work?
• Does she work? → Did she work?
• Where do they live? → Where did they live?
Правило: Do / Does → Did (для всех лиц). Глагол в начальной форме.
be: Am/Is → Was, Are → Were
Can → Could

Does he play? → Did he play?
